rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something together with A.

example.english: I had dinner alongside my mum.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 maa1 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when “alongside” means at the same time as something else, rather than together with someone.

example.english: I did my homework alongside listening to music.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 si4 zou6 gung1 fo3 tung4 teng1 go1

rows.note: Use this for physical proximity when something is beside A.

example.jyutping: ngo5 co5 hai2 nei5 gaak3 lei4

rows.note: Use this when A and the subject are explicitly arranged side by side.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 nei5 bing6 paai4 paau2
